description: In-repo reference for Google Tag Manager and dataLayer. This is not a GTM container import/export. For a full workspace backup, use Admin → Export Container in tagmanager.google.com.

measurementIds.ga4: Set via NEXT_PUBLIC_GA_MEASUREMENT_ID / GA_MEASUREMENT_ID (Web stream G-...)

businessFlows.purpose: Traffic, engagement, and lead capture before signup.
Signup and login funnel; pair with GA4 / Ads conversion tags in GTM.
Plans, checkout, purchase, refunds, subscription lifecycle.
Practice modes, AI feedback, vocabulary, audio.
Referral program and refund / withdrawal flows.

gtmOnlySignals.note: Fired from the app for Google Ads enhanced conversions; configure GTM tags to listen for this event only (see src/lib/gtm.ts).
Consent mode updates pushed when consent changes.

gtmChecklist: GA4 Configuration tag: Measurement ID from env.
Map GA4 Event tags (or one tag group) to the dataLayer event names listed under businessFlows.
Google Ads: conversions use GOOGLE_ADS_CONVERSION_ID and labels in google-ads-constants.ts / NEXT_PUBLIC_* overrides.
Register GA4 custom dimensions for attribution fields: utm_*, gclid, gbraid, wbraid, fbclid, msclkid, ttclid, attribution_source, purchase_type.
Listen for ads_enhanced_conversion separately from standard ecommerce events.
Use GTM Preview on staging and verify Network: /gtm/js and /g/collect (first-party rewrites in next.config.ts).
